headline: Tesla and SpaceX Form Committees to Evaluate Potential $3.2 Trillion Merger
summary: Tesla and SpaceX have formed evaluation committees involving five directors and three investment banks to explore a potential all-stock merger valued at $3.2 trillion.
why: Mergers involving large corporate entities can significantly alter corporate governance, capital structures, and equity valuations in the technology and automotive sectors.

impacts.name: Tesla
impacts.why: Evaluating a massive all-stock merger directly involves the equity valuation and corporate structure of Tesla.
